description: Selected capabilities grounded in accessible implementation and notebook evidence. Includes five areas and one engineering hub; not proficiency ratings or an exhaustive account inventory.

nodes.label: Web interfaces
nodes.detail: Catalogue interfaces, accessible interactions and server-rendered pages in the business applications.

nodes.label: React & TypeScript
nodes.detail: Typed components, application state and staff-facing product tools.

nodes.label: HTML & CSS
nodes.detail: Semantic page structure and responsive styling for public pages and administration interfaces.

nodes.label: Server rendering
nodes.detail: React server entry points render routes to HTML and dehydrate the query cache for the browser.

nodes.label: Responsive layouts
nodes.detail: CSS layouts adapt catalogue, navigation and content interfaces across screen sizes.

nodes.label: Route prefetching
nodes.detail: Route-specific data and component preloading prepare server-rendered product and content pages.

nodes.label: Accessible UI
nodes.detail: Dialog focus management, Escape handling and restoration of focus in React interfaces.

nodes.label: Spreadsheet tools
nodes.detail: Import and export of typed product records, with required-column checks and controlled updates.

nodes.label: Media processing
nodes.detail: Image compression, WebP thumbnails, dimensions and reference checks in media-publishing workflows.

nodes.label: Catalogue workflows
nodes.detail: Staff interfaces for editing product information, pricing and stock.

nodes.label: Backend & delivery
nodes.detail: Customer intake, staff permissions, analytics and checked release workflows.

nodes.label: Cloud Functions
nodes.detail: Firebase callable and server-side handlers implement privileged application operations.

nodes.label: CI & release gates
nodes.detail: GitHub Actions orchestrates tests, rule checks, builds and server-rendering verification.

nodes.label: Enquiry validation
nodes.detail: Backend handlers validate customer input, apply rate limits and persist enquiries.

nodes.label: Access-rule tests
nodes.detail: Firestore emulator tests check anonymous-write denial, administrator access and privilege-escalation attempts.

nodes.label: Firestore
nodes.detail: Document persistence and queries for products, enquiries, staff-related data and analytics.

nodes.label: Artifact integrity
nodes.detail: Release tooling creates SHA-256 manifests and checks immutable-asset collisions before deployment.

nodes.label: Staff sign-in
nodes.detail: Firebase Authentication connects staff sign-in with protected administration workflows.

nodes.label: Analytics pipelines
nodes.detail: Consent-aware event queues, batching and retries feed backend ingestion and scheduled reporting rollups.

nodes.label: Staff permissions
nodes.detail: Custom role claims and backend guards separate staff administration from content-management permissions.

nodes.label: ML & GPU systems
nodes.detail: Recurrent model implementations, GPU execution and checks against reference computations.

nodes.label: Python
nodes.detail: Model code, experiment runners, numerical checks and reproducibility utilities.

nodes.label: C++ & CUDA
nodes.detail: Native PyTorch extensions implement forward and backward recurrent-state computations on the GPU.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.detail: Trainable recurrent models, tensor operations and comparisons between reference and custom execution paths.

nodes.label: Triton
nodes.detail: Custom GPU kernels implement structured recurrent updates; source includes fused state-scan code.

nodes.label: State-space models
nodes.detail: Independent implementations of recurrent state-space models and structured memory, with separate experimental model families.

nodes.label: Custom autograd
nodes.detail: PyTorch autograd functions connect native forward and backward kernels to model training.

nodes.label: JAX & Flax
nodes.detail: A separate differentiable backend implements geometric operations, recurrent scans and Flax model modules.

nodes.label: Parallel scans
nodes.detail: Parallel recurrent-state computations are compared with sequential reference execution.

nodes.label: Numerical validation
nodes.detail: Reference-output and gradient comparisons, streaming equivalence and controlled execution checks.

nodes.label: Data & scientific computing
nodes.detail: Exploratory analysis and image-classification coursework, alongside exact-arithmetic research checks.

nodes.label: Pandas & NumPy
nodes.detail: Tabular analysis, grouped summaries and array operations in exploratory notebooks.

nodes.label: TensorFlow & Keras
nodes.detail: A convolutional animal-image classifier built and trained in a notebook.

nodes.label: Data preparation
nodes.detail: Column normalisation, missing-value handling and grouped data preparation in an aviation-analysis notebook. This is exploratory work.

nodes.label: Image classification
nodes.detail: Convolution, pooling, normalisation and dropout layers classify animal images in a notebook project.

nodes.label: Data visualisation
nodes.detail: Matplotlib and Seaborn charts communicate grouped data, learning curves and confusion matrices.

nodes.label: tf.data pipelines
nodes.detail: Image decoding, resizing, normalisation, batching and prefetching prepare training and validation inputs.

nodes.label: Exact arithmetic
nodes.detail: Rational and polynomial calculations with independent FLINT cross-checks in the mathematical research.

nodes.label: Model evaluation
nodes.detail: Training and validation curves plus confusion-matrix evaluation for the animal classifier.

nodes.label: Reproducible research
nodes.detail: Artifact manifests detect missing, altered and untracked result files, preserving the provenance of research outputs.

nodes.label: Java & .NET applications
nodes.detail: Event-driven Java projects, relational coursework and a Windows desktop prototype.

nodes.label: Java
nodes.detail: Plugin classes, commands and server-service integration using Java and the Paper/Bukkit ecosystem.

nodes.label: C# & .NET
nodes.detail: Windows application development through WinForms coursework and a WPF utility prototype.

nodes.label: Event-driven plugins
nodes.detail: Server events drive custom item behaviours and inventory interactions. Some item variants remain unfinished.

nodes.label: WinForms & ADO.NET
nodes.detail: Student and module management forms use data tables, adapters and parameterised database calls.

nodes.label: Resource-pack parsing
nodes.detail: JSON model files are parsed into custom items and categorised inventory interfaces.

nodes.label: SQL Server
nodes.detail: Parameterised SQL Server stored-procedure calls provide CRUD operations in C# coursework.

nodes.label: Persistent metadata
nodes.detail: Paper/Bukkit persistent-data containers attach custom metadata to items.

nodes.label: WPF & processes
nodes.detail: A Windows utility prototype launches external processes asynchronously and updates UI output through the dispatcher.

nodes.label: API integration
nodes.detail: Paper/Bukkit and Vault server-service integration, with ADO.NET database integration in separate C# coursework.
